videos.title: Your Health Matters - Magna Parks
videos.description: In this series Psychologist Dr. Magna Porterfield along side health and wellness coach Ron Porterfield, share their passions and insights regarding a holistic healing that connects mental and physical health.

videos.title: SUMtv Sabbath School Hour
videos.description: Our weekly Sabbath School Hour is deisgned to help you strengthen your understanding of God's word as we go through the quarterly Sabbath School Lessons together.

videos.title: SUMtv Worship Hour
videos.description: SUMtv Worship Hour is a weekly series that features a variety of speakers who earnestly present deep, edifying sermons based on the Word of God. Each sermon offers a different message using biblical prophecy, Christian doctrine, the present truth, practical Christian living, and biblical teachings through the lens of history. Tune in to find encouragement for strengthening your faith, renewing your spirit and living in harmony with God's will.

videos.title: The Better Way
videos.description: Thinking about getting married but feeling discouraged by the current state of society? This series presented by Pastor Octavian Poenaru may offer some reassurance that with God's leading, healthy relationships can last and even be restored. Learn the short and long-term negative effects of marital conflicts, the main predisposing factor for conflicts and how to develop a strategy for solving them.

videos.title: The Overcomers
videos.description: In this series you will hear some amazing testimonies of individuals whose lives have been transformed by the Lord.

videos.title: Anchor 2024: The Great Prophecies of the Old Testament Part II
videos.description: Anchor is a seminary-level course of study on the fundamentals of Seventh-day Adventist theology, taught by Pastor Stephen Bohr. The mission of ANCHOR is to settle students into the Truth both intellectually and spiritually and provide the theological skills to share with others the reason for the hope that is in them. Will your anchor hold in the coming storm?

videos.title: Equipping The Saints
videos.description: The church was never intended to be merely a social club for members but a training school for missionaries. This eye-opening series presented by Kameron Devasher will reveal God's original design for His people to be personally active in giving the gospel to the world, winning souls for His kingdom, and hastening the return of Jesus.

videos.title: The Heart of Babylon
videos.description: We are living in the "Time of the End" just before probation closes. Satan is doing his best to draft members of Gods Church into his Babylonian kingdom. Can you be called a Seventh-day Adventist, while really belonging to the Kingdom of Babylon?

videos.title: Misinterpreted Texts on the State of the Dead
videos.description: We live in a world captivated by the supernatural. Spiritualism has deeply influenced our media and entertainment. But what does the Bible actually teach about the state of the dead? Does the soul depart from the body at death? Are the righteous in heaven praising God? Are the wicked currently suffering in hell? In this enlightening series, Pastor Stephen Bohr explores these vital questions and more, offering clear, biblical answers about death and the afterlife.

videos.title: Silencing Satan
videos.description: Humanity has witnessed Satan’s relentless attempts to bring about destruction. In the face of such pervasive evil, sincere questions naturally arise - questions that may cause people to doubt God’s power, love, or even His very existence. This series confronts those challenging questions head-on, offering faith-affirming answers straight from God’s Word. Through hope and truth Satan can be silenced.

videos.title: The Best of I'd Like to Know
videos.description: The Best of I'd Like to Know revisits some of the series’ most compelling questions about the Bible, faith, and Christian life. Through Scripture-based answers and thoughtful discussion, these selected episodes invite you to discover timeless biblical truths, and deepen your understanding of God’s Word.

videos.title: SUMtv Sabbath School Hour
videos.description: Our weekly Sabbath School Hour is deisgned to help you strengthen your understanding of God's word as we go through the quarterly Sabbath School Lessons together.

videos.title: Unveiling Revelation - Pastor Carlos Munoz
videos.description: Have you found yourself wondering: What is going on in this world? If God is good how can he allow pain and injustice? In the limited understanding and infinite corruption of the world, we do not find answers that satisfy our souls. Only in God's Word and through the messages of Revelation can we find understanding, hope and peace.

videos.title: Come Out of Her My People
videos.description: Satan has sought to counterfeit God’s intimate gifts with self-centered indulgences, and sadly many have fallen for the deception. One of God’s most intimate gifts, sex, was created to foster deep connection within the covenant of marriage between a man and a woman. So how can we overcome sinful desires that go against His design? Not by our own strength, but by surrendering our thoughts to Jesus and allowing the Holy Spirit to transform our hearts.

videos.title: Take Heed Watch and Pray
videos.description: We are pilgrims and strangers in this world, traveling a path set with dangers from those who have rejected the only One who could save them. The adversary is on your track. Let us be faithful to trust, watch and pray.

videos.title: Mission Revival - Outpost Centers International

While Seventh-day Adventism has made it's mark, there are still areas of the world that have yet to be touched. This series will provide you with helpful ministry tips and inspiring testimonies of those who have answered the call to outreach ministry.
